about.creditsText: ProtoForge is a complete rewrite in .NET 10 and WPF (Fluent design with WPF-UI) of two community tools: Proto Manager and f2wedit. Their knowledge of the formats and their ideas live on here. Fallout is a trademark of its owners; ProtoForge contains no game data.
about.description: ProtoForge merges Proto Manager and f2wedit into one modern editor. It reads DAT archives, LST, MSG, PRO and FRM files natively, never changes a file without showing you what will be written, and gives you undo, mass editing, comparison, validation and JSON/CSV exchange.
